description: Lists the document templates published on the GUIEX website for a customs declaration: letters and self-declarations to be signed by the declarant, official forms of each authority and the procedures where a document is obtained, each with the document codes it goes with and the page where it can be read and downloaded. Filter by document code (for example Y900) or by words. Covers the EU customs tariff (TARIC) as applied in Spain (mainland and Balearic Islands). Not valid for the Canary Islands, Ceuta or Melilla. For guidance only, not binding.

document_code.description: Document code of 4 characters, for example Y900, C644 or 1414.

language.description: Language of the texts returned: Spanish (es), Catalan (ca) or English (en). Official EU texts not published in Catalan are returned in Spanish.

query.description: Words to look for in the title, the summary or the authority.

name: list_document_templates
title: Document templates for customs
